usage: 蚱蜢 (zaa3 maang2) is used as a noun to refer to the insect known as grasshopper.
When talking about insects, 蚱蜢 is commonly used to describe small green or brown grasshoppers that hop around plants.
You can use 蚱蜢 when talking about nature, gardening, or children catching insects.
In conversation, 蚱蜢 can be the subject or object of a sentence.
蚱蜢 is not usually used metaphorically; it refers directly to the insect.
